title: Reptile House Walk
hook: Build the enclosure around the species, not the sign color.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading herpetarium enclosure needs

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Reptile House Walk into a herpetarium microclimate tour because the mapping contains amphibians: each enclosure is read for heat, humidity, water, substrate, hiding and UVB needs, with no tapping or handling.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads enclosure labels and environmental controls rather than asking animals to swim/crawl/hop on cue.
